summary: Crescent BioPharma, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 8,094,793 ordinary shares and 525,897 pre-funded warrants at a public offering price of $14.50 per share, for total gross proceeds of ~$125 million. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under Form S-3, with joint book-runners Jefferies, TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities, and Cantor. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation.
